summary: A decision stopped applying because the subject of the work it was about changed before the work ran, and a new decision is asked in its place: by the claim in the same save, or, where an edit of the work's input withdrew a question still pending, by the next claim.

new.description: The approval by its identifiers, never its subject or its preview.

operation.description: The operation the work performs, by its id.

subject_hash.description: The digest of what was asked to be approved; the subject itself stays on the approval.
